content: Auth.js official docs include Google OAuth provider and Prisma adapter. Registry metadata shows stable next-auth 4.24.15 peers with Next 12-16 and React 17-19; current v5 is beta.32 only. The official v4 Next.js guide documents getServerSession in App Router server components. For this Next 15 greenfield, prefer the stable v4 API unless an explicit decision accepts v5 prerelease migration risk.
